description: Trace of every requirement in the 2026-11-14 brief to its current status. 'built' = implemented and published here; 'partial' = structure built with values blank/flagged per verification policy; 'exists' = delivered by a sibling hub (read-only reference); 'blocked' = cannot be completed without information that does not exist yet. Every row links a source.

rows.requirement: Price-snapshot store that records opening and closing numbers for every market we originate
rows.status: partial - store contract built, 0 market prices captured
rows.what_exists: Schema + validator in price-store/ (parallel session); coverage register here: 45 market records (15 games x side/total/moneyline) with our open line captured on all 45, our close 0, market open 0, market close 0.
rows.gap: No official public price source exists (the NFL's official betting feed is distributed to operators by an exclusive distributor), and no second capture of our own line runs yet.

rows.requirement: Verified results feed so backtests and ROI can be computed at all
rows.what_exists: Per-row feed transcribed first-hand from NFL.com weekly schedule pages (weeks 7, 8, 9 and the week-10 Thursday game), each row with the official week page and game-centre link; cross-checked against the committed snapshot: 27/27 agree, 0 mismatches.
rows.gap: Weeks 1-6 (93 games per the committed snapshot) are pending capture; ROI still additionally needs prices (REQ-01).

rows.requirement: Originate the side first, then the total, then the moneyline
rows.what_exists: compute.py originates and publishes in fixed order 1 side, 2 total, 3 moneyline; the moneyline is never produced before the side and total. All three fair lines published for the 15-game week-9 slate.
rows.gap: Order is enforced by this desk's pipeline only; the retired pipeline (results/originate.json) publishes different lines for the same games (FL-LD-07).

rows.requirement: Publish the model's fair line, the market line, and the difference as separate columns
rows.status: partial - three separate columns built; market and difference blank
rows.what_exists: Side, total and moneyline tables each carry fair line | market line | difference as separate columns, plus settlement against the official result.
rows.gap: Market line and difference are blank on every row: no official price source (REQ-01). Third-party closes exist in the repo but are not published here under the verification policy.

rows.requirement: Separate 'signal' from 'staking' in the leaderboard so a lucky staking run cannot mask a bad signal
rows.status: built here - signal rank and staking rank computed separately
rows.what_exists: Signal rank uses only gates + outcome statistics (gates desc, BH-adjusted p, raw p, n); staking (ROI, CI) is reported in its own block and never enters the rank. Demonstration: the best staking rank (S7, +1.5% ROI) is signal rank 5 of 7; the best signal rank (S6) is staking rank 3.
rows.gap: The root leaderboard still ranks 'by gates passed, then by ROI' (flag PS-F3 raised by the price-store session); changing the root rule belongs to the root owner.

rows.requirement: Track the depth of the replacement, not just the fact of a replacement
rows.status: partial - store and schema built; every depth cell blank
rows.what_exists: Replacement-depth store with per-row replacement_player / replacement_string (1st-4th) / depth_source fields; 11 official injury rows from a first-hand Week 10 read.
rows.gap: No official source states replacements or string tiers: the official report has no depth column (verified first-hand) and the league depth-chart path returns HTTP 404 (verified first-hand). All depth cells blank + flagged.

rows.requirement: Compute correlations only from officially sourced numbers and publish n with each value
rows.what_exists: Every coefficient computed only from NFL.com standings transcriptions (2026 n=32, 2025 n=32, pooled n=64); n and a 95% Fisher-z interval published with each value (NIST method).
rows.gap: Window limited to two seasons because standings are transcribed by hand; extending seasons is a capture task, not a method gap.

rows.requirement: Define a demotion gate that sends a live strategy back to paper
rows.what_exists: Promotion checks P1-P3 and demotion gates D1-CLV (price-store, CLV side), D2-outcome (this desk: n>=200 and one-sided 95% ROI upper bound < 0), D3-integrity (HOLD, never demote on missing data). Dry run on the 7 committed candidates: 0 promoted, 0 demoted, all stay PAPER.
rows.gap: No strategy is live (0 of 7 pass promotion), and D1 has no price input, so the gate is defined and tested but has no live subject. Thresholds are proposals, not an official standard.

rows.requirement: Research and develop strategies for useful signals; singles, parlays, player prop combos; validation gates; remove luck; skill-based selection
rows.what_exists: Root Line Lab + quant-lab, origination-lab, skill-lab, lineup-lab, pipeline/origination hubs publish 7-31 strategies each, 10-gate validation, FDR/luck controls. 0 strategies qualify anywhere; rewards are unpaid design.
rows.gap: Consolidation of gate names and reward schedules across hubs remains open (verify-hub RB reconciliation); no strategy has cleared any gate set.

rows.requirement: Leaderboard competition that rewards top-performing strategies
rows.what_exists: Signal-ranked leaderboard with reward schedule design (Tier 1 = 10/10 gates); 0 of 7 qualified, 0 points payable.
rows.gap: Reward pool is not funded and jurisdiction/eligibility terms are undecided (carried flag from sibling hubs).

rows.requirement: System tracks injuries and defensive/offensive deficiencies (2nd/3rd/4th-string replacements)
rows.status: partial - official injury facts tracked; deficiency unmeasurable
rows.what_exists: Official Week 10 injury rows (status/practice) first-hand; sibling hubs carry fuller weekly captures (decision-desk 254 rows, review-board 213 rows - their scopes).
rows.gap: Deficiency = f(injury, depth of replacement). Depth is blank everywhere (REQ-06), so the deficiency signal stays uncomputed rather than proxied.

rows.requirement: A dedicated suggestions section to review before any change is implemented
rows.what_exists: 12 proposals with effort/impact/risk/dependency, all 'proposed - awaiting reviewer'; nothing implemented from this desk without a reviewer choice.
rows.gap: Sibling hubs hold overlapping suggestion registers; a canonical index is proposed (SG-10).

rows.requirement: Clear list of questions, information and answers needed before any decision, with suggestions to discover missing information
rows.what_exists: 15 questions with what we have / what is missing / where to find it / discovery action; unanswered items blank, not guessed.
line-desk/EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY.md and the Executive page: headline numbers, what is verified, what is blocked.

rows.requirement: Repo review line by line; verify from official sources with links; flag irregularities
rows.what_exists: Repo review with inventory, checks run, and 16 flagged irregularities each carrying an official or repo source link.

rows.requirement: GitHub Pages site: clean landing page, subpages by category, dashboard-style tables with sources
rows.what_exists: line-desk/index.html + 14 category pages, generated deterministically; every table row ends in a source link.
rows.gap: Root navigation link requested from the integration owner (not edited here).

rows.requirement: Verification: every row sourced; unverifiable values blank and flagged; never infer
rows.what_exists: verify.py enforces: per-row source link on every table row, blank-unverified rows in JSON, market price fields null by policy, deterministic rebuild, strict JSON.

rows.requirement: Parallel-session coordination via COORDINATION.md; claim before work
rows.what_exists: Claim RD-0 written and pushed before any work; conflicts on the board resolved keeping every session's entries.

rows.requirement: PR to main, merge, GitHub Pages deploy confirmed, recorded in COORDINATION.md
